content: For the Bayes classifier f_Bayes(x)=x_1+η∑_{i=2}^{d+1}x_i, the risk expressions in Eq. (5) imply, under the common-feature condition 0<η≪1 and d≫1, that as d grows the OOD detection risk increases sharply (so increasing d can markedly increase OOD risk).
